message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the DLL component scope during the last 24 hours. The mandatory dedicated MongoDB ecosystem sweep also found no issue published within the scan window.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-24 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-25 07:40 UTC (2026-10-24 13:10 IST through 2026-10-25 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, and CISA sources.

CVE-2026-115929 for MongoDB Compass was reviewed but excluded from the findings because its authoritative publication timestamp, 2026-10-24 01:17 UTC, precedes the scan cutoff by about 6 hours 23 minutes. Source: [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r9qr-cj53-q38x).

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based solely on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan. Continue normal monitoring and routine dependency hygiene.
